items.question: How does slow drinking of air at the tongue-palate root destroy old age and death after one year and prevent serpent poison?
premises: Air is drunk slowly at tongue-palate root.
One year of practice destroys old age and death.
Poison does not enter body even if bitten by great serpents.
items.inference: The practice grants immunity and longevity.
items.plain_english: Having made air at the root of tongue and palate, one should drink slowly; when practiced for one year, old age and death are destroyed; poison does not enter the body even if bitten by great serpents.
